items.translation: 定义分词的本地化设置。

items.source:
Enable stemming of input text to reduce words to their base form, for example
stemmer, stemming, stemmed are based on stem.
items.translation: 启用输入文本的词干提取功能，将单词还原为其基本形式。例如，stemmer、stemming 和 stemmed 均基于 stem。
跳过停用词，不进行索引。

items.source:
Apply standard analyzer to SASI indexing. This analyzer is used for analysis that involves stemming, case
normalization, case sensitivity, skipping common words like "and" and "the", and localization of the language used
to complete the analysis
items.translation: 将标准分析器应用于 SASI 索引。该分析器用于涉及词干提取、大小写规范化、大小写敏感性处理、跳过常见单词（如“and”和“the"）以及确定所用语言以实现分析的文本分析。
